faq.q: What is the maximum group size for a Marbella boat rental in 2038?
faq.a: For most large yachts in our fleet, the maximum is 12 passengers. This includes the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 Flybridge, Ferretti 94, and K80. Smaller boats like the Dubhe (5 pax) or Speedboat (6 pax) have lower limits. Always check the specific boat's capacity when booking.

faq.q: Can I rent a boat for a group of 15 people in Marbella?
faq.a: No, our largest vessels accommodate a maximum of 12 passengers due to safety regulations and licensing. For groups larger than 12, consider splitting into two boats or choosing a larger charter elsewhere. Contact us via WhatsApp to discuss options for your party size.

faq.q: Which boat is best for a group of 10 people?

faq.q: Are children counted in the passenger limit?
faq.a: Yes, every person on board, including infants and children, counts toward the maximum passenger limit. This is a strict safety regulation enforced by Spanish maritime authorities. Ensure your total group size, including kids, is within the boat's capacity.

faq.q: What if my group is smaller than the boat's capacity?
faq.a: Smaller groups are welcome on any boat. You can book a larger yacht for extra space and luxury, or choose a smaller vessel like the Dubhe (5 pax) for a more intimate experience. Prices are based on the boat and duration, not per person.

faq.q: How do group size limits affect pricing in 2038?

All our charters depart from Puerto Banús, and every vessel has a strict maximum passenger count based on safety regulations and licensing. Whether you're a couple seeking intimacy or a dozen friends ready to party, we break down the limits so you can choose the perfect boat for your group.

Why Group Size Limits Matter for Marbella Boat Rentals

Group size limits aren't just arbitrary numbers—they're enforced by Spanish maritime law to ensure safety, comfort, and legal compliance. Exceeding the limit can result in fines, denied boarding, or even cancellation of your trip. In 2038, these regulations remain unchanged, so always confirm the capacity before booking. Our fleet ranges from 5 to 12 passengers, giving you flexibility for any party size.

Best Boats for Small Groups (2–6 People)

For intimate outings, consider the Dubhe (5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (5 pax)—perfect for a romantic sunset cruise along the Golden Mile. The Speedboat (6 pax) and Red Tide (6 pax) offer more space for a small family or group of friends. These smaller vessels are more affordable and easier to dock at coves like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés.

Best Boats for Medium Groups (7–11 People)

Groups of 7–11 will find excellent options. The Bandido (8 pax) is a sporty choice, while the Astondoa 40 (9 pax) and Azimut 39 (11 pax) provide comfort and style. For 10 passengers, the Pershing 46 or Lagoon 380 are ideal. All include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks—just show up at Puerto Banús.

Best Boats for Large Groups (12 People)

If you're celebrating with a dozen friends, our Mangusta 80 (24m), Ferretti 94 (29m), or Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) are top picks. The Mangusta 80 even includes a free jet ski with its 4-hour minimum charter at €4,719. These yachts offer ample deck space, sunbeds, and shade. For a similar experience, the K80 (24m) and Canados 86 (26m) also max out at 12 pax.

Pricing Based on Group Size

Remember, you pay per boat, not per person. For example, the Astondoa 40 (9 pax) costs €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours—perfect for smaller groups. The Mangusta 80 (12 pax) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours. All prices include 21% IVA, skipper, fuel, soft drinks, beer, wine, cava, and light snacks. For other boats, pricing is on request via WhatsApp.

Tips for Booking with a Large Group

  • Book early, especially in peak summer (June–September), as 12-pax yachts are in high demand.
  • If your group exceeds 12, consider splitting into two boats—we can coordinate simultaneous departures from Puerto Banús.
  • Check the weather: Calm seas mean smoother sailing for larger groups.
  • Communicate any dietary restrictions for snacks and drinks.
  • For stag or hen parties, ask about special packages when you [contact us](/).
